messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8672 fired -> Node unresponsive: gpu-node-03a-az1 (us-east-1a). Alert reason: kernel panic + kubelet NotReady. Autopager fanout to /eng-oncall.
pagerduty: Incident created: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-8672 severity: P1
sasha: acked. I'm oncall and looking. tagging @miguel for level-2 if we need serial.
miguel: on my way. quick ask — any customer traffic impacted? I can take handoff in 2.
ops-lead: seeing elevated 502s from dedicated clusters routed to that rack. Customers possibly impacted: acme-inc-prod and bobcat-analytics. I'll pull dashboards.
infra-bot: node heartbeat lost at 2026-03-15T02:10:13Z. last kubelet seen: 2026-03-15T02:09:59Z. Serial session drop observed.
sasha: running quick checks. `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-03a-az1 -o wide` output:
```
NAME              STATUS     ROLES    AGE     VERSION
gpu-node-03a-az1  NotReady   <none>   168d    v1.27.3
```
sasha: checking pod impact: 7 pods scheduled on node, 2 are dedicated customer workloads. listing:
```
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-03a-az1
acme-infer-0   Running  2/2  300Mi  gpu-node-03a-az1
bobcat-req-1   Running  1/1  150Mi  gpu-node-03a-az1
batch-worker-3 Terminating 0/1 100Mi gpu-node-03a-az1
... (4 more)
```
miguel: can you try attaching serial console? I'll request access now.
sasha: attaching serial console:
```
# socat /dev/ttyS0,raw,echo=0 TCP:serial-gateway:2000
<output truncated> kernel: BUG: panic occurred ...
Call Trace: ...
```
sasha: kernel panic stack trace present, NVMe I/O errors immediately prior. probable host-level hardware failure.
ops-lead: customer impact confirmed: spike in 502s for acme-inc around 02:10 -> autoscaling kicked but some requests failing. Not global but high-impact for those tenants.
pagerduty: Escalating to responder group infra-hardware (level 2)
miguel: taking handoff — I'll coordinate reboot/reimage and RMA if needed. sasha, can you cordon the node and start safe drain of tenant pods?
sasha: cordoning node now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-03a-az1
node/gpu-node-03a-az1 cordoned
```
sasha: starting drain (graceful) for non-critical workloads, leave customer pods last:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-03a-az1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
```
sasha: two pods stuck Terminating (acme-infer-0 and batch-worker-3). trying force delete for terminated kubelet-unresponsive case.
```
kubectl delete pod acme-infer-0 --grace-period=0 --force
pod "acme-infer-0" deleted
```
infra-bot: eviction notices sent to scheduler; pods rescheduled across us-east-1a pool. Some cold starts observed for acme-inc workloads.
tara: raising a support ticket to affected customers (ACME/Priority) with ETA for mitigation. I'll include logs and request they route traffic to fallback region in the meantime.
miguel: serial showed NVMe SMART errors and repeated I/O timeouts. plan: powercycle once, if no improvement -> reimage and escalate to RMA. I'll run a soft powercycle now.
sasha: powercycle issued to BMC for gpu-node-03a-az1.

# ~10m later
miguel: soft cycle didn't clear kernel oopses, host won't come back cleanly. scheduling reimage + RMA. I've opened infra-ticket INF-4124 and RMA request with vendor.
ops-lead: mitigation status: pods evicted and failing over; dedicated customers seeing reduced errors after reschedule ~+6m. still monitoring for slow warmup and throttling.
sasha: updating incident PD-8672 with notes, will follow up with post-incident review. action items: (1) RMA + isolate hardware, (2) investigate NVMe fleet telemetry for similar failures, (3) improve autopager suppression for repeated kernel panics on same host to reduce noisy fanout.
miguel: handing back to sasha once RMA scheduled. leaving runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/node-hardware-failure
sasha: acknowledged handoff. creating draft postmortem and notifying customer success. closing thread here once vendor confirms RMA pickup. :white_check_mark:
